title: Production passive checks: frontend verified; API, TLS and email DNS not verifiable
unverified_reason: Allowed the two production hosts via a personal 'empire-x' environment on 2026-11-05. TLS results reflect the sandbox's TLS-intercepting proxy, not Vercel/Render. The API did not respond (F-030). DNS tooling for SPF/DKIM/DMARC is not available here.
expected: Production headers, TLS configuration, robots/sitemap/security.txt, email DNS (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) and one Lighthouse run checked read-only.
actual: Frontend (verified 22:37 UTC): HSTS max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload (Vercel); X-Frame-Options DENY; nosniff; Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin; Permissions-Policy set; CSP as F-016; X-Powered-By: Next.js present; robots.txt, sitemap.xml (4 static URLs only), manifest.json and RFC 9116 security.txt (Contact + Expires 2027-11-02) all served. Not verified: backend headers (API unreachable), TLS protocol/cipher policy, email DNS, Lighthouse.
impact: Hosting-layer settings (Vercel/Render headers, TLS, DNS) are unknown.
fix: Allow the two hosts, then re-run the passive checks.
